Our client is an international market leader in consumer electronics, with a strong presence in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and further develop the commercial partnership with the partner operating the four branded stores in Belgium.
• Build and maintain a strong relationship with a major Belgian telecom operator, ensuring its propositions are effectively integrated into the stores.
• Take commercial ownership of a business representing approximately. 
• Act as the central point of contact between the customer, telecom partner and internal Sales, Retail, Marketing and Supply Chain teams.
• Translate commercial strategies into concrete actions and initiatives at store level.
• Coordinate and follow up promotional plans across multiple product categories.
• Manage internal and external approval processes and ensure commercial initiatives are implemented correctly and on time.
• Prepare and monitor sales forecasts in close collaboration with Supply Chain.
• Analyze commercial performance and identify opportunities to further drive sales and business growth.
• Prepare and present commercial updates, results and business plans to key stakeholders.

• Similar experience in a commercial role such as Account Manager, Key Account Manager or Business Developer.
• Strong commercial mindset and comfortable taking ownership of an important customer portfolio.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate different and sometimes competing interests.
• Strong analytical capabilities and comfortable working with forecasting, sales data and commercial reporting.
• Confident communicator with strong presentation skills.
• Assertive and resilient: able to defend your position, ask the right questions and take ownership.
• Strong team player who enjoys working within an experienced and commercially driven team.
• Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Fluent French and English are mandatory, with French required at a very strong professional level due to the customer and stakeholder environment.
• Dutch is an advantage, with a willingness to further develop the language considered important.

Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator/Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

Robert Half is looking for a Customer Service Representative (Italian/French/English) (M/F/X) in Zaventem.

Do you have excellent knowledge of Italian, French and English? Are you looking for a permanent position within a dynamic and international team? We are seeking a customer-oriented, detail-focused team player for a growing company in the diplomatic sector.

Your responsibilities:

• Customer contact by phone and email;
• Maintain and update customer files (including specific customs documents);
• Perform daily checks, checklists, and follow up on overdue files;
• Work with proprietary software; fast and comfortable using PC;
• Collaborate with internal colleagues and external partners.

Profile:

• Excellent Italian, French and English required; -
• You must have a bachelor or masters degree.
• You live in Belgium and are eligible to work here.
• You can reach the company easily (Zaventem)
• Accurate and detail-oriented, affinity with administrative processes
• Team player, able to work independently; flexibility is a must
You must meet all requirements to be considered for this position.

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French

As part of a broad IT digitalization program, significant investments will be made over the coming years in renewing and optimizing processes, applications and digital services. To support this transformation, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can immerse themselves in the business and help determine where and how digitalization can genuinely create value.
This is a long-term project within a stable enterprise environment, with contracts that can be renewed annually.

A role where your work really makes a difference

Do you love helping people, finding solutions and working in an international environment? Are you someone who enjoys travelling, discovering different cultures and dealing with new situations every day?

 

Our client is looking for an Administrative Technical Assistant to join a dynamic assistance team. In this role, you will be the person people turn to when they need help sometimes in unexpected or stressful situations. Your ability to listen, reassure and find the right solution can have a real and immediate impact on someone's day.

This is a highly varied role where people skills are just as important as administrative skills.

Your responsibilities

• Be the first point of contact for people requiring assistance and provide empathetic, professional support
• Handle incoming calls and assess each situation to identify the best solution
• Open, manage and follow up on assistance files from A to Z
• Coordinate repatriations, travel arrangements and medical assistance
• Organise travel and practical arrangements for doctors and other professionals
• Coordinate with different internal and external stakeholders to ensure the right solution is found
• Keep files accurate and up to date, ensuring a smooth follow-up throughout the process
• React quickly to unexpected situations and adapt your priorities accordingly
• Take ownership of each situation and make sure the person receiving assistance feels properly supported

Your profile

• You have a mature, empathetic and genuinely helpful personality
• You enjoy finding solutions rather than simply identifying problems
• You have previous experience in a customer service, call centre, administrative, travel, assistance or similar environment
• You are organised and comfortable managing several files and priorities at the same time
• You remain calm and solution-oriented, even when situations are stressful or unexpected
• You enjoy travelling and have an open-minded, adventurous mindset - someone who is comfortable dealing with different cultures, situations and people
• You are flexible, pragmatic and not afraid to think outside the box
• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English
• You enjoy working as part of a close-knit team and are willing to fully embrace a role involving shift and weekend work

Middlegate Europe is a leading player in European logistics and distribution. With operational sites

in Zeebrugge, Liège, and Hull, the company combines innovative processes with a strong focus on safety,

quality, and operational reliability. To strengthen the team in Zeebrugge, Middlegate Europe is looking for an

International Truck Driver.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Responsible for delivering goods within the specified time frame. 

• Complying with legal driving and rest periods. 

• Assisting with loading and unloading trucks and ensuring the cargo is secured. 

• Ensuring the vehicle is kept in perfect condition and clean. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a valid CE driver’s license. 

• You have some initial experience as a CE driver. 

• You are punctual, professional, and thorough in your work. 

• You speak Dutch or English well. 

• You have a flexible mindset. 

• You’re willing to spend the night on location.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Senior IT Recruiter (Permanent & Freelance Talent Solutions)
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility. Driven by its ambition to grow and industrialize, Inetum generated Sales of EUR2.5 billion in 2023.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At inetum, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job description

 
• We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Recruiter to help us attract and engage top technology talent across Belgium. This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying opportunities and finding solutions in a competitive talent market.
 
• You have a strong network within the IT sector, are comfortable approaching candidates directly, and know how to build credibility with both candidates and business stakeholders. You combine recruitment expertise with a commercial mindset and enjoy working closely with the business to achieve results.
 
• You will play a key role in attracting both permanent employees and freelance consultants, partnering closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to support the continued growth of the business.
 
• As a Senior IT Recruitment Partner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for both permanent and freelance IT positions. You will act as a trusted advisor to the business, bringing market insights, challenging assumptions and helping hiring managers make informed talent decisions.

Key responsibilities

 
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for permanent and freelance IT profiles
 
• Proactively source and engage high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, networking, referrals, events and other sourcing channels
 
• Build, maintain and leverage a strong network within the IT and technology market
 
• Conduct candidate interviews to ensure both technical and cultural fit
 
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process and create an excellent candidate experience
 
• Partner closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to understand hiring needs and business priorities
 
• Challenge and advise stakeholders on talent availability, market realities and recruitment strategies
 
• Develop creative sourcing approaches to identify niche and hard-to-find profiles
 
• Stay informed about technology trends and developments within the talent market
 
• Act as an ambassador for the company and contribute to strengthening our employer brand

Additional information

...

Experience & skills:

• Minimum 5 years of recruitment experience within IT or technology recruitment

• Proven experience recruiting both permanent employees and freelance consultants

• Strong sourcing capabilities with a track record of successfully filling challenging roles

• Well-established network within the IT and technology community

• Commercial mindset and strong relationship-building skills

• Able to influence, challenge and advise stakeholders at different levels of the organisation

• Genuine interest in technology and the IT market

• Resilient and persistent in your approach to recruitment

• Strong communication and negotiation skills

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

• Knowledge of French is an asset

Functie
For our client in Meer, we are looking for a maintenance technician.

• As a maintenance technician, you are responsible for repairing technical malfunctions in the production machines.
• The issues can be both electrical and mechanical, but the majority are industrial electrical faults. You are responsible for identifying the malfunction and resolving it.
• In addition, you carry out equipment overhauls.
• You ensure that operators and production staff can continue working at all times.
• Preventive and major maintenance tasks are carried out on Saturdays.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English
• You are willing to work in a shift system. In addition, you will work on Saturdays and can take a compensatory day off during the week (not on Monday or Friday)
• Knowledge of PLCs and/or I/O configuration (not programming) is a plus
• You are flexible with working hours and can work both independently and in a team
• You are willing to work in varying temperature conditionsWat je van ons krijgt

• You will work in a family-oriented environment with a flat organizational structure. There is a strong and collegial atmosphere among colleagues

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an established investment management organisation based in Brussels, operating in an international and highly regulated environment. The offices are easily accessible and offer the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders on strategic compliance matters.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the compliance and risk framework
• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of new regulatory requirements
• Oversee AML/CFT activities and participate in related control and reporting processes
• Support interactions with regulators, supervisory authorities and regulatory filings
• Assess and monitor outsourced service providers and ICT-related risks
• Provide compliance support across fund operations, including investment monitoring and conflict assessments
• Participate in regulatory analyses supporting new jurisdictions, fundraising activities and cross-border operations

• Master's degree in Law, Finance or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Compliance position
• Experience within an AIFM, investment fund, private equity, venture capital, asset management or another regulated financial services organisation
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are valuable assets
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, compliance controls and risk management practices
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with multiple internal and external stakeholders

Our client is a well-established, renowned non-profit advocacy organization with a long-standing commitment to its core mission.They focus on raising public awareness, influencing policy, and driving meaningful change to advance welfare and rights.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Communications, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Mix of strategic planning and hands-on execution, including planning major campaigns while managing daily communication activities.
• Direct involvement in content creation (press releases, social media copy, newsletters, campaigns).
• Oversight of all communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, print), with internal coordination across functions.
• Team management 
• Regular collaboration with external agencies and partners.
• Strong focus on creativity and innovation, combined with agency-driven input.
• Budget management.
• Fast-paced, reactive environment requiring also reporting and performance tracking.

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a marketing position
• Able to manage projects, budgets, and teams (leadership and teamwork skills)
• Strong command of digital marketing tools, web analytics, and marketing techniques
• Knowledge of various marketing channels (social media, press relations, advertising, etc.) and how to use them effectively depending on the target audience
• Excellent writing skills
• Fluent in Dutch & French mandatory, with good command of English

Description

• Provide high-level executive support, including complex diary management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, expense management, and preparation of briefing materials.
• Organise internal and external meetings, seminars, lunches, and corporate events.

• Fluent English and French, both written and spoken. Additional European languages (German, Spanish, or Italian) are a plus.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and strong administrative and organisational skills.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly discreet, with excellent interpersonal skills.

Are you a highly organised and discreet Personal or Executive Assistant looking for a role where trust, flexibility and attention to detail are essential? Our client is a high-level private individual with several companies and international activities, looking for an experienced PA/EA to provide both professional and personal support.

 

This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys a high level of responsibility, varied priorities and working closely with a demanding but dynamic principal.

Your responsibilities as Executive and Personal Assistant

• Manage a complex and constantly changing agenda.
• Coordinate meetings, appointments and travel arrangements.
• Organise and accompany the client during international travel when required.
• Handle confidential information with a high level of discretion.
• Coordinate communication with internal and external contacts.
• Support the client with both professional and occasional personal matters.
